name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina. A completed Pre-Feasibility Study outlined Proven and Probable reserves of approximately 124 Moz silver and 1.1 Moz gold grading 91 g/t Ag and 0.81 g/t Au. The company graduated from the TSXV to the TSX in February 2025 and also trades on the OTCQX under the symbol ABBRF.
